units.source_text: 洞穴中，笼罩着伸手不见五指的幽暗，外面却是皓月当空。

en.t: Inside the pit, there was a darkness so deep that you could not see your hand in front of your face, while outside the bright moon hung high in the sky.

units.source_text: 沙子与天空的分界线上，男人们的影子看上去成了模糊的一团。

en.t: Along the line where the sand met the sky, the men's shadows looked like a single blurred mass.
